source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p32
s: In which year the Nagarjuna sagar Dam was constructed?
x: Nehru laid the foundation of Nagarjuna Sagar Dam on 10 December 1955; Indira Gandhi released water to the left and right bank canals on 4 August 1967.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p32
s: In which year did Hyderabad state get its freedom from Nizam rule?
x: Hyderabad state was liberated from the Nizam on 17 September 1948 through Operation Polo.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p32
s: Satavahana kings who ruled Andhra belonged to the Which caste?
x: The Nasik inscription addresses Gautamiputra Satakarni as Eka Brahmana, so they are considered Brahmins; the Puranas call them Shudras.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p32
s: In which year 'History of Andhras' was published?
x: Vignana Chandrika Mandali published the History of Andhras, written by Chilukuri Veerabhadra Rao, in 1910.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p32
s: Who was Nagarjuna?
x: Acharya Nagarjuna was a Buddhist philosopher, founder of Mahayana Buddhism and contemporary of Yajna Satakarni.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p32
s: Who is the author of the book "Sakshi"?
x: Panuganti Lakshminarasimha Rao, known as Andhra Shakespeare, wrote Sakshi. Sri Sri wrote Mahaprasthanam.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p32
s: Who among the following was the second Portuguese traveler to visit Vijayanagara during the reign of Achyutaraya?
x: The Portuguese traveler Nuniz visited Vijayanagara during the reign of Achyuta Devaraya; Domingo Paes and Barbosa came under Krishnadevaraya.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p32
s: Who is the author of 'Panchatantra'?
x: Vishnusharma wrote Panchatantra in Sanskrit based on Gunadhya's Brihatkatha. Paravastu Chinnaya Suri wrote Neeti Chandrika.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p32
s: Kakatiya king Ganapatideva ruled South India during which year?
x: Ganapati deva, the greatest and longest reigning Kakatiya, ruled from 1199 to 1262.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p32
s: The Andhra patriot was the only great businessman?
x: Pattabhi Sitaramayya wrote the history of the Indian National Congress and is known as the founder of Andhra Bank.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p32
s: Who wrote the song 'Bharatha khandambu chakkati padi aavu.......' during the independence struggle?
x: Chilakamarthi Lakshmi Narasimham wrote this song during a meeting in Rajahmundry on Bipin Chandra Pal's visit to Andhra.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p32
s: Thimmarusu is the Minister of which of the following?
x: Thimmarasu served as minister of Krishnadevaraya, who called him Appaji.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p32
s: Whose daughter is Rani Rudrama Devi?
x: Rani Rudrama Devi was the daughter of Ganapati deva and ruled with the title Rudramaharaju.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p32
s: A traveler named Nuniz visited the Vijayanagara Empire during the reign of Achyuta Deva Raya. He is from which country?
x: Nuniz, who visited Vijayanagara during Achyuta Deva Raya's reign, was Portuguese.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p32
s: Who started the Vyavaharika Bhasha movement for Telugu language?
x: Gidugu Ramamurthy is known as the father of the Vyavaharika Bhasha movement.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p32
s: During the time of Kakatiyas land revenue called?
x: During the Kakatiya period land revenue was called Ari, usually 1/5 of the produce.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p32
s: Who designed the logo of Andhra University?
x: The Andhra University symbol was designed by Kauta Ramamohana Sastri.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p33
s: Who wrote the idolatry of Krishnadevaraya in his book?
x: Domingo Paes describes the facial features of Krishnadevaraya.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p33
s: Who authored the Sanskrit text 'Mahanataka Sudhanidhi'?
x: Devaraya-II, known as Prauda Devaraya, was a poet who wrote Mahanataka Sudhanidhi; his literary hall was called Mutyala Shala.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p33
s: When did Vasco da Gama reach Calicut?
x: Vasco da Gama reached Calicut in 1498, when Immadi Narasimharaya was the Vijayanagara king.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p33
s: Who started the bhoodan movement?
x: Acharya Vinoba Bhave started the Bhoodan movement at Pochampally, Telangana in 1951.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p36
s: In which year the Simon Commission visited Andhra?
x: On 3 February 1928 a hartal was organised in all Andhra towns against the Simon Commission, which reached Madras on 26 February 1928.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p36
s: The Vijayanagara Empire was built on the banks of which river?
x: The Vijayanagara empire was built on the banks of the Tungabhadra; Harihara and Bukka first established it with Anegondi as capital in 1336.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p36
s: Ramappa temple was built during which kings?
x: During Kakatiya Ganapati deva's time, his general Recherla Rudra built the Ramappa Temple at Palampet in 1213 AD; it became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2021.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p36
s: Lingayats prayed to?
x: Lingayats are followers of the Veerashaiva religion founded by Basaveshwara and worship Lord Shiva.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p36
s: Kondapalli famous for?
x: Kondapalli toys are wooden toys made of Tella Poniki wood in Kondapalli village near Vijayawada and have a GI tag.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p36
s: Which of the following is a South Indian place known as a trading center of the Romans?
x: During the Satavahana period Arikamedu was an international trade centre doing business with Rome.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p36
s: Main language of Dravidians?
x: The Dravidian languages are mainly Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p36
s: Who were the first Europeans to start trading with India?
x: The Portuguese were the first Europeans to trade with India, but the Dutch were the first to start business with Andhra.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p36
s: Who founded the Ikshvaku dynasty of Andhra Pradesh?
x: Vasishtiputra Shantamula overthrew the last Satavahana Pulomavi-III and established the Ikshvaku kingdom at Vijayapuri (Nagarjunakonda).

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p36
s: Popular Telugu magazine for children?
x: Chandamama, a children's monthly, was started from Madras in July 1947 by B. Nagireddy and Chakrapani.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p36
s: Vijayanagara paintings were found here?
x: Vijayanagara era paintings of Mahabharata and Ramayana stories are found on the ceilings of the Lepakshi temple.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p36
s: Who was the contemporary of Kancherla Gopanna?
x: Kancharla Gopanna (Bhakta Ramadas) lived in the time of Abul Hasan Tanisha and built the Sri Rama temple at Bhadrachalam.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p36
s: Who established Vignana Chandrika Granthamala?
x: Komarraju Lakshmana Rao established Vignana Chandrika Grandha Mandali in Hyderabad in 1906.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p36
s: In which year did Nehru appoint the State Reorganisation Committee (SRC)?
x: Nehru formed the State Reorganisation Committee under Fazal Ali in 1953; it submitted its report in 1955.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p36
s: Bahmani- Vijayanagara kingdoms often fought for which region?
x: The Bahmani and Vijayanagara kingdoms frequently fought over the fertile Raichur Doab between the Krishna and Tungabhadra.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p36
s: Andhra University was established in which year?
x: Andhra University was started on 26 April 1926 at Vijayawada with C.R. Reddy as first Vice Chancellor; it moved to Visakhapatnam in 1930.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p37
s: Who is the Andhra national leader who was sentenced to 14 years imprisonment in the Kakinada bomb case and moved to the cellular jail in the Andaman Islands?
x: Prathivadi Bhayankara Venkatachari, a militant revolutionary accused in the Kakinada bomb case, was imprisoned in the Andaman jail.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p37
s: Aurangzeb's conquest of Golconda?
x: Aurangzeb annexed Golconda to the Mughal Empire in 1687 during the reign of Abul Hasan Tanisha.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p37
s: What does the Vilasa Tamra Inscription describe?
o: Conditions after the fall of the Kakatiya kingdom
Southern political conditions after Tallikota war
x: The Kakatiya kingdom fell in 1323 to Muhammad bin Tughlaq; the Vilasa grant describes this and the liberation movement led by Musunuri Prolaya.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p37
s: Where was the first girls' school established in Andhra?
x: Kandukuri Veeresalingam established the first girls' school in 1874 at Dhavaleswaram near Rajahmundry.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p37
s: Who founded the magazine 'Hindu Reformer'?
x: The Hindu Reformer was founded by Mannava Buchaiah Pantulu.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p37
s: Charminar was built to commemorate what?
o: Success in the prevention of plague
x: Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah built Charminar in 1593-94 to mark the eradication of plague in Hyderabad.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p37
s: Who among the following is known as 'Andhra Shivaji'?
x: Parvataneni Veeraiah Chowdary, known as Andhra Shivaji, led the Pedanandipadu tax satyagraha in 1922 and formed the Shanti Sena.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p37
s: Who built 'Nedumbasadi' for Jains?
x: Ayyana Mahadevi, wife of Kubja Vishnuvardhana, built a Jain basadi in Vijayawada, per the Musinikonda inscription.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p37
s: Who built the thousand pillared temple of Hanamkonda?
x: The thousand pillared (Rudreshwara) temple in Trikutalaya style was built by Rudradeva in 1163 at Hanamkonda.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p37
s: First Deputy Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh?
x: Neelam Sanjiva Reddy was the first CM of Andhra Pradesh in 1956, but no Deputy CM was appointed during his time.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p37
s: Only one revolt occurred in the third part of the 19th century?
x: During the 1857 revolt, a rebellion was led by Korukonda Subbareddy in East Godavari district. The Rampa and Rekapalli revolts took place in 1879.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p37
s: First widow remarriage in andhra?
x: The first widow remarriage in Andhra was performed at Kandukuri Veeresalingam's house in Rajahmundry on 11 December 1881.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p37
s: Classical dance in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Kuchipudi is the classical dance of Andhra Pradesh; Siddhendra Yogi is considered its father.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p37
s: The title of Duggirala Gopalakrishnaiah?
x: Duggirala Gopalakrishnaiah was called Andhra Ratna; Deshbandhu was C.R. Das and Deenabandhu was C.F. Andrews.
